How we work

From first call to first day, without the guesswork.

Day 1

We learn the role

A recruiter who knows your field sits down with your hiring manager to agree skills, budget and timeline.

Days 2 to 7

We find and vet

Our US and India teams search, screen and interview. You only see people we would hire ourselves.

Days 8 to 14

You meet the shortlist

Interviews are scheduled around your calendar. Feedback goes straight back to the recruiter.

Day 15 onward

We support the start

Offers, onboarding and payroll are handled. We check in with both sides after the first 30 days.

Specialist recruiters

Teams organised by field, so the person calling you understands the job description.

Both sides of the ocean

Hire in the US, India or both, with one contract and one point of contact.

Every hiring model

Move from contract to direct hire, or keep people on our payroll, as needs change.

Payroll and compliance

Third-party payroll handled end to end so your team focuses on the work.

Fast, honest timelines

Clear weekly updates, and a straight answer if a search needs more time.

Candidates treated well

Plain feedback, fair offers and a recruiter who stays in touch after placement.
